## Description

Add tests/scratch/test-scratch-cleanup.sh with RED cases for `_scratch_cleanup_for_ticket`:
1. Removes existing per-ticket scratch directory, returns 0.
2. No-op when scratch directory absent, returns 0.
3. Idempotent — two consecutive invocations both return 0 with no scratch dir remaining.
4. INFO log line contains ticket id and removed path on successful removal.
5. On rm failure (read-only parent dir), WARN log emitted; writes per-ticket orphan marker `.tickets-tracker/.scratch-orphans/<id>` JSON with `ticket_id`, `path`, `error`, `timestamp`; still returns 0.

Test sources ticket-lib.sh and invokes helper directly — does NOT shell out through transition/archive.
